Maya: Quick note 62; draft "launch lanes" playbook for routing + multi-region isolation. Link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/lanes-draft

Maya: Proposal: three lanes (soft-affinity, guarded-affinity, strict-residency). Each lane = gates + fallback behaviors + expected sales path.

Ravi: map lanes to offering: soft = self-serve Hosted, guarded = sales-assisted Hosted, strict = Dedicated/Private.

Sam: add mandatory rollback/evacuation checklist per lane. last cutover pain was region-order confusion.

Lina: Sales needs a 2-bullet promise per lane. Keep it narrow.

Maya: Guarded gating idea: p95 <300ms, tracing + audit logs, committed capacity doc.

Jesse: I'll collect top customers for each lane and flag strict-residency requirements.

Ravi: infra wants a small policy DSL: preferred_region, failover_region, tenant_quota, enforcement_mode. infra owns runtime; product owns semantics.

Sam: infra will prototype DSL. Product to own canary tests (prompt sets, latency cohorts).

Maya: Milestones: M1 guarded alpha (8w) = routing primitives + metrics. M2 residency pilot = enforcement + billing/contract flow.

ops-bot: Task created: https://tasks.internal/lanes/M1 assigned Maya,Ravi,Sam due 8w from 2923456789.

Maya: Action items: Jesse -> customer matrix (EOD Fri); Ravi+Sam -> DSL sketch + rollback playbook (next Tue); Lina -> GTM checklist (next Wed); Maya -> PRD consolidate.

Lina: propose "isolation readiness" score (5 checks -> 0-100) for GTM tracking.

Sam: will help define signals.

Maya: I'll post PRD link here when ready. Ping me for review.
